svg.title: What each shuffle changes
svg.desc: Dependence interventions shown as two-scenario illustrations. Each grid has two equally weighted scenarios and six consecutive hours; blue cells are at/below the threshold and orange cells exceed it. Single denotes the full six-hour window at A; Both requires the same window at A and B. Every intervention preserves per-hour marginal values. Space shuffling preserves single-turbine trajectories. The real experiment uses 57 scenarios and three fixed shuffle repetitions, not the two illustrated paths.
svg.text: Rows 1–2: equal-weight paths; columns 1–6: consecutive hours
A window: all six hours at A; A & B: all six hours at both turbines
Illustration: same hourly values, different complete windows
